title: Quality categories canvas
description: Registry of named quality categories used by the reviewer agent's `lens=quality` runs.

id.description: snake_case identifier; cited on findings as `category: <id>`

patterns_to_flag.description: Heuristic prompts (not hard regex) the reviewer scans against the diff.

counter_examples.description: Cases where the pattern is fine — reduces false positives.

severity_hint.description: Default severity for findings in this category. Reviewer can override per-finding.

disabled.description: Project-level override to suppress a plugin-default category. Reviewer skips the entry when true.
